notes.title: Discount on PictoQuest in support of Puppy Cross!
notes.notes:
Hi there! 

Because of our shared love for friendly nonograms and cute creatures, we decided to do a cross-promotion with the fellow French developers of Puppy Cross, which just got a new free DLC focused on 🐱 kitties 🐱. 

For a limited time starting TODAY, you’ll benefit from a 25% discount on PictoQuest and a 40% discount on Puppy Cross! What are you waiting for?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1183500/Puppy_Cross/
